supersedes.why: v1 was written before docs/marketing/CAMPAIGN_ART_DIRECTION_V1.md existed and is named in that document's Known Gaps as needing a redo pass. It hardcoded the site identity (#070907 ground + #7CFC00 glow) into every prompt regardless of subject — the exact 'stuck in this damn black and green' failure the art direction corrects — and it used quality adjectives ('cinematic', 'editorial') where the OpenAI image-prompting cookbook calls for photography vocabulary. v1's eight generated plates remain on disk as plate-01..08-*.jpg with their receipt entries intact; they are superseded as art direction, not deleted as evidence.

palette_source_of_truth: marketing/creative/templates/famtastic-social-frame.jsx (var PALETTES) — RGB read directly from the shipped template, not restated from memory.

technique_ref.source: OpenAI Cookbook — gpt-image-1.5 prompting guide, as recorded in CAMPAIGN_ART_DIRECTION_V1.md Rule 4
applied: Prompt order: intended use -> scene/background -> subject -> key details -> camera and light -> colour world -> reserved negative space -> exclusions -> preserve list. Assembled in that order at run time by generate-plates.mjs assemblePrompt().
Short labelled segments and line breaks rather than one long paragraph.
State the intended use so the model sets its own level of polish.

Photography vocabulary for realism (50mm/35mm, eye level, soft diffuse, film grain, real wear) instead of quality adjectives; '8K', 'ultra-detailed' and 'studio polish' are explicitly excluded rather than requested.
An explicit exclusion list at the end of every prompt.
A preserve list restated on every prompt so an iteration cannot drift the palette, framing or the no-text rule.
not_applied: In-image text techniques (quoted literals, ALL CAPS, verbatim-rendering demands). FAMtastic's rule stands: type is set in Photoshop, never generated. Every prompt here carries the opposite instruction.
Character anchor / input_fidelity workflow. No recurring illustrated brand character exists yet; when one does, the anchor image belongs in this library as its own topic.

hard_constraints: No baked-in text of any kind, anywhere, in any plate.
Every plate reserves deliberate negative space for Photoshop-set type, declared per variant in `negative_space`.
Every plate names exactly one palette, and that palette comes from the campaign's own subject matter — not from the house identity by default.

famtastic.use_when: FAMtastic is talking about FAMtastic — the offer, the system, the price, the product itself.
famtastic.prompt_clause: near-black ground, #070907, a deep neutral black with a faint green cast, filling most of the frame. Exactly ONE saturated accent anywhere in the image: a restrained lime green, #7CFC00, present as a single light source, rim light or reflected edge and nothing more. Every other light is neutral or cool-neutral white. No warm domestic light, no second colour, and no green wash over the whole scene — the lime is an accent, not the ambience.

ghost-town.use_when: The argument is absence: a business that exists but cannot be found. Heat, dust, weathering, abandonment.
ghost-town.prompt_clause: warm near-black earth ground, #17120D, a dark dusty brown. ONE warm amber accent, #D9A441 — low late sun, a sodium lamp, or dust caught in a single shaft of light. Everything else bleached, dry and desaturated: bone, sand, faded paint, grey weathered timber. No blue, no green, no neon, no cool light anywhere.

salon.use_when: Personal-service work — hair, nails, barbering, beauty. Skin-adjacent warmth, close and human.
salon.prompt_clause: deep plum-black ground, #1A1013, low and enveloping. ONE dusty rose accent, #E8B4B8 — a warm practical bulb, a mirror light, skin catching light. Soft, close, intimate, slightly underexposed. Never clinical white, never surgical, no cyan, no fluorescent green cast.

trades.use_when: Work, not lifestyle — automotive, contractors, repair, mobile service, anything with tools in it.
trades.prompt_clause: blue-black ground, #0D1117, cold and industrial. ONE safety-orange accent, #FF7A1A — a work lamp, a hi-vis panel, a painted hazard edge. Everything else cold steel neutral: grey primer, galvanised metal, oil-dark concrete. No warm domestic light, no golden hour, no wood-panelled warmth.

paper.use_when: Anything that must read sober rather than as an ad — documents, proposals, ownership, credibility, LinkedIn. A light ground is a first-class option, not an exception.
paper.prompt_clause: LIGHT ground, not dark. Warm off-white paper, #F4F1EA, fills the frame — daylight, soft and diffuse, gentle low contrast, honest paper and wood texture. ONE deep green ink accent, #1F6F4A, small and printed-looking. This is a daylight photograph: no black background, no glow, no night, no studio seamless sweep, no dramatic side light.

anchor-take-a.measurement: 5 frames, 113,000 px. Mean luminance 161.9/255. Accent occupies 1.31% of frame area.
anchor-take-a.use_when: A plate must sit next to HeyGen take-a in the same cut. This is the anchor's measured appearance, not a brand specification.
anchor-take-a.prompt_clause: Warm neutral daylight interior. Overall a LIGHT frame - mean luminance around 160 of 255, near-white walls at #FAFDF9, shadows falling to a muted mauve-grey around #33272E. Never a dark or near-black ground. Exactly ONE small olive-green accent object, #7FB449, occupying roughly one to two percent of the frame - a trim detail, a spine, a small object on a desk. Never a lime field, never a green gradient, never a wash. The accent reads olive under this light, not chartreuse.

shared.use_case_clause: a background plate for a marketing asset. Display type is set over it afterwards in Photoshop, so this image is the surface, not the finished piece. Set polish accordingly: real and restrained, not advertising-slick.
shared.photography_clause: Photograph it, do not illustrate it: real optics, natural depth of field, one dominant light source, visible film grain, and honest material wear — scuffs, dust, fingerprints, faded paint, worn edges, uneven surfaces. Ordinary and unstaged, as if caught in the moment on a working day. Do not render it as 8K, ultra-detailed, hyper-real, studio-polished, cinematic, or heavily retouched.
shared.no_text_clause: Text rule (absolute): render zero text. No letters, numerals, words, handwriting, printed copy, signage lettering, screen copy, UI labels, packaging copy, captions, subtitles, watermarks, signatures, logos or brand marks anywhere in the frame — including on paper, screens, clothing, vehicles, tools and boxes. Where the scene would normally carry writing, show that surface blank: blank cards, blank paper, blank sign panels, dark or face-down phones. All type is set in Photoshop afterwards; a plate that arrives with generated lettering is unusable.
shared.exclusion_clause: Exclude: a second saturated colour, rainbow gradients, neon signage, lens-flare stars, HDR halos, teal-and-orange grading, blown highlights, low-contrast haze, obvious stock-photo posing, plastic retouched skin, real identifiable people or celebrities, extra or malformed fingers, cloned faces, 3D-render or CGI look, vector or illustration look, dutch tilt, heavy motion blur, collage, borders, frames, device mockup edges, and any object not named above.
shared.preserve_clause: Preserve on every revision: the colour world, the reserved empty area, the framing and lens, the single dominant light source, and the complete absence of text. Change only what a revision explicitly asks to change; do not alter anything else.

negative_space_clauses.right-column: Reserved negative space (mandatory): the right 45% of the frame stays near-empty — one continuous, low-detail surface with no subject, prop, hard edge, hard shadow or high-contrast texture crossing into it. Compose the subject into the left half. That empty band is where large display type lands in Photoshop; anything placed there will be covered or will fight the type. The emptiness must be REAL DEPTH IN THE SCENE - an actual wall, sky, ceiling or surface receding naturally with its own soft light gradient, grain and imperfection. It is NOT a blank panel, card, sheet, sticker, overlay, crop or flat rectangle placed on top of the photograph or painted onto an object. Never introduce a hard straight edge, a colour block or a uniform fill to create it. If the scene cannot provide that emptiness honestly, re-frame the shot until it can.
negative_space_clauses.left-column: Reserved negative space (mandatory): the left 45% of the frame stays near-empty — one continuous, low-detail surface with no subject, prop, hard edge, hard shadow or high-contrast texture crossing into it. Compose the subject into the right half. That empty band is where large display type lands in Photoshop. The emptiness must be REAL DEPTH IN THE SCENE - an actual wall, sky, ceiling or surface receding naturally with its own soft light gradient, grain and imperfection. It is NOT a blank panel, card, sheet, sticker, overlay, crop or flat rectangle placed on top of the photograph or painted onto an object. Never introduce a hard straight edge, a colour block or a uniform fill to create it. If the scene cannot provide that emptiness honestly, re-frame the shot until it can.
negative_space_clauses.lower-third: Reserved negative space (mandatory): the bottom 40% of the frame stays near-empty — one continuous low-detail surface (floor, counter, ground, wall) carrying no subject, prop or high-contrast texture. Weight everything into the upper two-thirds. That empty band is where display type lands in Photoshop. The emptiness must be REAL DEPTH IN THE SCENE - an actual wall, sky, ceiling or surface receding naturally with its own soft light gradient, grain and imperfection. It is NOT a blank panel, card, sheet, sticker, overlay, crop or flat rectangle placed on top of the photograph or painted onto an object. Never introduce a hard straight edge, a colour block or a uniform fill to create it. If the scene cannot provide that emptiness honestly, re-frame the shot until it can.
negative_space_clauses.upper-half: Reserved negative space (mandatory): the top 50% of the frame stays near-empty — one continuous low-detail surface (wall, sky, ceiling, seamless ground) carrying no subject, prop or high-contrast texture. Weight the subject into the lower half. That empty band is where display type lands in Photoshop. The emptiness must be REAL DEPTH IN THE SCENE - an actual wall, sky, ceiling or surface receding naturally with its own soft light gradient, grain and imperfection. It is NOT a blank panel, card, sheet, sticker, overlay, crop or flat rectangle placed on top of the photograph or painted onto an object. Never introduce a hard straight edge, a colour block or a uniform fill to create it. If the scene cannot provide that emptiness honestly, re-frame the shot until it can.
negative_space_clauses.center-band: Reserved negative space (mandatory): keep a clean horizontal band across the middle third of the frame empty and low-detail. Subject interest sits above and below it; nothing crosses it. Type is set into that band in Photoshop. The emptiness must be REAL DEPTH IN THE SCENE - an actual wall, sky, ceiling or surface receding naturally with its own soft light gradient, grain and imperfection. It is NOT a blank panel, card, sheet, sticker, overlay, crop or flat rectangle placed on top of the photograph or painted onto an object. Never introduce a hard straight edge, a colour block or a uniform fill to create it. If the scene cannot provide that emptiness honestly, re-frame the shot until it can.
negative_space_clauses.full-field: Reserved negative space (mandatory): this is an atmosphere plate, not a picture of a thing. No focal subject, no readable object, no strong compositional anchor anywhere. The whole frame is one even, quiet field with gentle variation only — type will be set across all of it. The emptiness must be REAL DEPTH IN THE SCENE - an actual wall, sky, ceiling or surface receding naturally with its own soft light gradient, grain and imperfection. It is NOT a blank panel, card, sheet, sticker, overlay, crop or flat rectangle placed on top of the photograph or painted onto an object. Never introduce a hard straight edge, a colour block or a uniform fill to create it. If the scene cannot provide that emptiness honestly, re-frame the shot until it can.

topics.title: Pillar — Why Gmail and Linktree Cost Your Business Revenue
topics.claim: A free email address and a rented link page quietly cost you credibility and money at the moment a customer decides whether to trust you.
topics.object: Two blank business cards: the same business, printed twice, one on good stock and one cheap. The plate supplies the cards; the two addresses are set in Photoshop, which is where the argument actually lands.

topics.palette_argument: Blue dusk with one warm shopfront is literally the picture of 'found first', and the cold/warm split is the trades palette's own physics.

variants.scene: A small-town street at blue dusk, wet asphalt, no people.
variants.subject: A row of shopfronts across the lower third of the frame with every window dark except one, which glows warm orange.
variants.details: No signage panels anywhere, reflections on the wet road, a cold blue sky above, empty.
variants.camera: 35mm, eye level from across the street, blue dusk with one warm practical, natural grain.

variants.scene: A sidewalk at dusk looking along a shopfront wall.
variants.subject: One lit doorway in the lower third of the frame throwing an orange wedge of light onto cold wet concrete.
variants.details: A blank sign bracket above the door, cold blue shadow, a puddle catching the light.
variants.camera: 35mm, low eye level, blue dusk with one warm source, visible grain.

variants.scene: A dark street corner at dusk, cold and blue.
variants.subject: A single lit shop window in the upper half of the frame, the only warm thing in the picture, its display shelves empty.
variants.details: Cold blue reflections in the neighbouring dark glass, a bare bulb inside, no lettering on the window.
variants.camera: 50mm, eye level, blue dusk with one warm practical, shallow depth of field.

topics.title: FAM-MAINTENANCE — kept healthy while you run the business
topics.claim: Maintenance is invisible when it works, which is why nobody buys it until it fails.
topics.object: A machine that has obviously been looked after, and a service tag with nothing written on it.
topics.palette_argument: Maintenance is workshop work. The palette should look like a place where someone actually services things.

variants.scene: A plant room under cold light, painted block wall.
variants.subject: A blank paper service tag hanging on a wire from a valve in the lower half of the frame, completely unwritten.
variants.details: The tag creased and slightly stained, an orange valve handle behind it, conduit above bare.
variants.camera: 50mm, eye level, cold diffuse light with one orange element, shallow depth of field.

variants.scene: A workshop bench under cold overhead light.
variants.subject: An oil can and a torque wrench laid side by side in the lower third of the frame, both clearly used and clean.
variants.details: An orange-painted handle, oil sheen on the bench, worn knurling, the wall above empty.
variants.camera: 50mm, eye level with the bench, cold light, shallow depth of field.

variants.scene: A machine housing photographed close under cold shop light.
variants.subject: A clean inspection panel with an orange grease nipple and a wiped-down seam in the upper half of the frame, all surfaces unmarked.
variants.details: Fresh grease at the nipple, a faint wipe pattern in the dust, no plates or stampings anywhere.
variants.camera: 50mm close-up, eye level, cold diffuse light, shallow depth of field.

topics.title: And If It Is — Rattler Lifers (alumni / reunion)
topics.claim: The people are still here. The place is where they agree to meet.
topics.object: A closed yearbook, empty bleachers, a locker bank — the physical memory of a shared place.
topics.palette_argument: Nostalgia here is archival, not atmospheric: bound paper, ink, daylight. One frame moves to ghost-town because an empty stadium at last light is genuinely a place-that-is-empty picture.

variants.scene: A table in soft daylight, warm off-white surface.
variants.subject: A closed hardbound book lying in the lower third of the frame, its cover cloth-bound and entirely blank with no title, emboss or lettering.
variants.details: Worn cloth at the spine corners, a green ribbon marker, a faint water mark on the cover, dust on the table.
variants.camera: 50mm, high angle over the table, soft daylight, shallow depth of field.

variants.scene: An empty outdoor stadium at the very end of the day, dust in the air, no people.
variants.subject: A bank of weathered timber and metal bleachers running across the left half of the frame, empty, low sun raking along the rows.
variants.details: Peeling paint on the risers, dry grass at the base, long amber shadows down the steps.
variants.camera: 35mm, eye level from the field, low amber sun, heavy natural grain.

variants.scene: A school corridor in flat daylight from a high window.
variants.subject: A bank of painted metal lockers filling the lower half of the frame, doors closed, every number plate blank and unstamped.
variants.details: Dented door faces, chipped paint at the latches, scuffed terrazzo below, the wall above bare.
variants.camera: 35mm, straight on, eye level, soft daylight, natural grain.

variants.scene: A desk in soft daylight, seen from above.
variants.subject: An open register book in the upper half of the frame with completely blank, unruled, unwritten pages.
variants.details: A green pen laid in the gutter, soft paper fibre, a faint thumb smudge, the desk below empty.
variants.camera: 50mm directly overhead, flat daylight, low contrast.

defect_log.defect: The model rendered 'the top 50% stays near-empty' as a literal blown-out white rectangle painted across the upper half of a front door - a hard-edged panel, not compositional emptiness. Unusable.
defect_log.root_cause: The reserved-negative-space clause described the RESULT (an empty band) without forbidding the wrong MECHANISM (pasting a flat panel onto the scene).
defect_log.fix: All five negative_space_clauses now require the emptiness to be real depth in the scene and explicitly forbid a blank panel, card, sheet, overlay, crop, hard straight edge or uniform fill.
defect_log.detection_note: Two automated detectors were written to audit the other 20 plates and BOTH failed. The first false-negatived this exact defect; the second flagged plates whose pale bands are INTENDED reserved space while still missing it. The defect was found by looking at the image. Do not trust a flat-region heuristic for this class - use the critique-* skills, or look.
